_about: Proofs that capture_proof.js --export copied in from a captured page, with a fingerprint (sha1) of each. Only these can be replaced or removed by a later export, and only while the file still has this fingerprint. Every other proof is the owner's: drop a file named <influencer id>---<influenced id>.png into images2.0/proof/, or upload over a captured one, and no export touches it.
